purpose: Validates an electronic transferable record (eBL or other ETR) against MLETR functional-equivalence tests (Arts. 10–12: singularity, control, integrity, reliability) and scores cross-corridor legal enforceability from the UNCITRAL adoption status. Answers: will this eBL hold up at both ends of the corridor?
